alice.chen: heads up — onboarding gemma-lite -> qwen-bridge run shows a token splice mismatch when using the bridgehead rotary adapter. low-level logs attached.
ben_k: can you paste the failing output?
alice.chen: here's the short repro and logs. model emits normal tokens until token 8 then diverges; kvcache indices look shifted. snippet:
```
sh
# convert + quick infer
python convert.py --src gemma.pt --dst qwen.bridge.ckpt --adapter bridgehead --mode headwise
python run_infer.py --model qwen.bridge.ckpt --prompt 'Hello world' --max_tokens 24
```
log excerpt:
"kv_put index=512 -> key_id=513"
"rotary_phase: expected dim=64 got dim=64 (ok)"
"kvcache: read mismatch at step=8 token=512 vs token=513"
carmen: hmm looks like the adapter is concatenating head dims instead of interleaving, causing the kvcache to shift. did the export apply a head-permute?
alice.chen: converter v2.1 was used, config: rotor_mode=headwise, token_splice=split. i didn't explicitly set head-permute.
devin: quick check — run with --no-kv-cache to see if raw autoregressive decode matches. if no-kv-cache matches, it's definitely a kvcache index mapping bug.
alice.chen: ran with --no-kv-cache, outputs align exactly. with kvcache enabled they diverge after 8 tokens :thinking_face:
ben_k: that strongly indicates an index shift in how we assign token->slot mapping. maybe the tokenizer aliasing changed BOS id between gemma and qwen and the adapter didn't account for the sentinel offset.
carmen: also double-check tokenizer normalization. gemma assets use NFKC only; qwen uses NFKC+lowercase in current build. a remapped BOS or SENT token could shift everything.
alice.chen: i diffed token ids; most map 1:1 but BOS is remapped from 1 -> 0 in the qwen vocab. that would produce a persistent -1 offset in kvcache indices.
devin: easy mitigation: in bridge adapter inject a detected-bos-offset normalization during conversion and add a validation step that runs a short kvcache roundtrip compare. i'll open a tiny patch.
alice.chen: note — reproduced on fp16 and int4 quant runs. quantization not the root cause.
ben_k: good catch. after the patch we should run the perplexity+chat-quality suite to catch any subtle shaping regressions.
ml-bench: request received, will run BENCH-9123 (perp+chat) after integration succeeds.
ci-bot: build #4267: unit tests for adapter-converter passed; integration step failed (kvcache-integration). details: https://ci.redwood/4267
ops-bot: scheduled canary rollback rule added for model qwen-bridge-2024-11-02 in Dedicated to reduce blast radius.
devin: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/bridge-adapter/pull/58 — adds bos-offset detection + kvcache roundtrip test.
ben_k: i'll add a conversion pipeline guard to run a tiny generate-roundtrip on the converted artifact before promoting.
alice.chen: triage checklist updated in thread: Devin makes patch -> CI integration green -> ml-bench run -> promote if pass. thanks all :thumbsup:
